pass_a_gloss: Transgressions who will-understand? out-of the hidden-things of-me cleanse me, and from aliens spare the servant of-you. The and Aquila the of-aliens of-proud rendered. Upon for the succeeding the passion, there-is when this follows, being-puffed-up upon this of-the mind; and through other again they-are-unhorsed way, such-as the apostolic, that not having-been-puffed-up into judgment he-fall of-the devil, necessarily having-said-beforehand: And for the servant of-you keeps them, he-entreats to-be-delivered of-the pride; from which sin being great having-been-cleansed, blameless I-will-be from pride, together also of-the hidden-things having-been-cleansed; now for not-yet I-dare.
pass_b_english: “Who will understand transgressions? Cleanse me from my hidden things, and spare your servant from aliens” (Psalm 18:13-14).

And Aquila rendered “aliens” as “the proud.” For upon those who succeed, this passion sometimes follows, the mind becoming puffed up at this; and by another way they are again thrown, such as the apostolic saying, “lest being puffed up he fall into the judgment of the devil” (1 Timothy 3:6). Having necessarily said beforehand “For your servant keeps them,” he entreats to be delivered from pride; having been cleansed from this sin, which is great, I will be blameless from pride, at the same time also having been cleansed of the hidden things; for now I do not yet dare.

choices.english: Aquila rendered aliens as the proud
choices.why: Aquila’s Greek, not a different lemma. ἀλλότριος kept as aliens, glossed proud.
rejected: Aquila rendered aliens as strangers only

choices.term: ἐπὶ τοῖς κατορθοῦσι τὸ πάθος … χαυνουμένης τῆς διανοίας
choices.english: upon those who succeed, this passion follows, the mind becoming puffed up
choices.why: Pride follows success. OCR πά θος. Not ‘passion of those who fail’.
rejected: the passion belongs to those who fail
the mind is emptied of passion

choices.term: ἵνα μὴ τυφωθεὶς εἰς κρίμα ἐμπέσῃ τοῦ διαβόλου
choices.english: lest being puffed up he fall into the judgment of the devil
choices.why: 1 Timothy 3:6 as printed. OCR ι να. Not ‘fall into the devil’s praise’.
rejected: lest he fall into the devil’s praise
